known_parity_gaps: GAP-load-claude-canonical-no-events: load_claude_code and load_canonical success paths do not return EventList rows in Rust; load_events_for_format for those format ids stops at the loader seam before events.
GAP-load-valueerror-repr: Unsupported and not-vendor ValueError messages use Python repr, including None and quoted strings; Rust matches Display text but vectors do not exhaust every format arm.
GAP-load-reader-limits: Python passes ReaderLimits into all loaders; Rust LoadLimits forwards only fields each vendor loader accepts (see load.rs).
GAP-load-codex-secret-tracker: load_codex_rollout accepts an optional SecretScanTracker; load.py passes None. Rust always passes None.

GAP-load-payload-content-hash: load_events_for_format on codex-rollout stops at sesslint._canonical_codec.payload_content_hash before returning events; Python test_codex_dispatch load_events row is not_applicable.
GAP-load-scan-cli-bundle: tests/test_codex_dispatch.py rows that call scan_path, cli.main, export_to_canonical, api.build_bundle, or api.verify are outside this adapters.load card.
